speaker: Doctor
text:
Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me exactly what strange behaviors your husband has been exhibiting lately, and when did this start? 

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis (to rule out substance toxicity or metabolic causes).

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Appearance: Clear; WBC: 0-5 /HPF; RBC: 0-2 /HPF; Nitrites: Negative; Leukocyte_Esterase: Negative

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Patient
text: creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant medical or psychiatric history reported. Social history: Previously employed. No history of substance abuse reported. Married.

speaker: Patient
text: No significant findings. Denies any drug use, recent travel, or physical health issues. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Tuberculosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see; given the prior suggestion of Tuberculosis, have you noticed any persistent fever, night sweats, or significant weight loss alongside his agitation? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the normal chest X-ray; this makes active Tuberculosis and primary psychiatric disorders less likely. Did he report any visual disturbances like flashing lights or colors, or any auditory hallucinations, specifically regarding smelling burning rubber? REQUEST TEST: Electroencephalogram (EEG).

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Wilson's Disease (presenting with neuropsychiatric symptoms).

REQUEST IMAGES: Liver Ultrasound, Slit-Lamp Examination (Kayser-Fleischer rings).
